scene: Three secret departure docks click open along the gallery floor.
picture: In a wide side view along a polished brass gallery floor, the player stands at the centre facing forward in his teal bomber jacket. On the far left hangs a neon ferris wheel gondola. Left of centre sits the glowing projector pedestal. On the right waits a brass book cart lift, and on the far right an open garage door reveals a purple night bus.
